chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Yusuf ibn 'Aqil, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, that he said:
Concerning a man who killed his mother, he said: “If it was by mistake, then he has his share of her inheritance; but if he killed her deliberately, then he does not inherit anything from her.”

key_terms.خَطَأً: accidentally; an unintended act of killing

ai.seo_question: Does a son inherit from his mother if he killed her accidentally or intentionally?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning inheritance when a son kills his mother. It distinguishes between accidental killing and intentional killing: accidental killing does not bar inheritance, while deliberate killing prevents the killer from inheriting from the victim.
